chunks: My father narrated (may God be pleased with him) that Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated from his father, from Isma'il ibn Marar, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said:
The signs of blood are four: itching, pimples, drowsiness, and dizziness.
ai.seo_question: What are the four signs of blood according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Al-Khisal*, this hadith from Imam al-Rida (AS) identifies itching, pimples, drowsiness, and dizziness as indicators of blood conditions, reflecting the integration of clinical observation with humoral medicine in Shia tradition. It underscores the Imamate's role in preserving both spiritual and physical well-being, linking bodily signs to the balance of humors as understood in classical Islamic medical theory.
